title: Contravariant exactness of unbounded ringed internal Hom
statement: For any small ringed site and commutative ring sheaf, in any derived universe, for each fixed M the functor RHom(-,M) from the triangulated opposite derived category admits a coherent integer CommShift structure making it triangulated. There are no boundedness or finiteness hypotheses. The derived category and internal Hom are those of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-derived-internal-hom].

proof.text: Choose a complex K representing M and put I equal to its functorial K-injective replacement [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. The existing ordinary localization comparison for [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], restricted to the fixed second variable K, naturally identifies RHom(Q(-),QK) with Q HomComplex(-,I). Transport along QK ≅ M. All derived-category universes remain as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

Use the closed symmetric monoidal structure on sheaves of modules [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. The already proved homComplexIsoInternalHomObj multiplies the degree-n factor indexed by p by (-1)^(p*n), identifying [def-pur-hom-complex] with the signed bifunctor Hom model for the ordinary internal-Hom bifunctor. Check naturality in the contravariant variable on each product projection using homComplexFunctor_map_f_π and bifunctorHomMapLeft_f_π; the same scalar occurs on both sides. The signed bifunctor Hom object is definitionally the native internal-Hom complex, a conversion performed over an abstract category. Compose the comparison with quotientCompQhIso and lift its naturality from complexes to the homotopy quotient, whose precomposition functor is fully faithful. This gives a natural isomorphism F ≅ Qh.op ⋙ RHom(-,M).

Apply [lem-sf-bifunctor-homotopy-exact] to the ordinary internal-Hom bifunctor and the fixed complex I. Its separately additive bifunctor hypotheses follow from pre_add_app and additivity of each ihom functor. This supplies a coherent integer shift structure making F triangulated. Transport the shift structure along the preceding natural isomorphism through the localization Qh.op. Its compatibility is provided by commShiftOfLocalization; the inverse comparison is compatible by cancellation. The exact homotopy localization [lem-pur-homotopy-category-triangulated] has an essentially surjective arrow functor (calculus of fractions), so isTriangulated_of_precomp detects triangulatedness of RHom(-,M) with this very shift structure [def-weil-triangulated-category]. No separate normalized source or target shift interface is needed.

theorem ringedInternalHom_contravariant_exact
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u}
    RingCat.{u})).obj R))] :
    (∀ M : (DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u}
    RingCat.{u})).obj R))), ∃ _ : ((Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom.{u, w} J R)).flip.obj
    M).CommShift ℤ,
    ((Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom.{u, w} J R)).flip.obj M).IsTriangulated)
